subject.title: Embedded agent: auto-rotate (or persist a marker) on context-overflow give_up instead of wedging the session until manual /reset

question: Should exhausted embedded-agent context-overflow recovery persist a durable overflow-blocked state, auto-rotate and replay the pending turn once, or keep manual recovery with clearer visibility?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally preserve the session mapping after failed overflow recovery, while the issue asks to change core recovery and durable state behavior for autonomous agents.

options.title: Persist blocked state first
options.body: Add a durable overflow-blocked marker and operator-visible recovery affordance without silently replaying a turn on a new session.

options.title: Guarded one-shot rotation
options.body: Rotate and replay once after compaction and truncation are exhausted, with replay-safety gates and a per-session loop cap.

options.title: Keep manual recovery
options.body: Keep the documented `/reset` or `/new` contract and improve only visibility, diagnostics, or docs.

recommendation.title: Persist blocked state first
recommendation.body: Add a durable overflow-blocked marker and operator-visible recovery affordance without silently replaying a turn on a new session.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses session state, gateway visibility, and product recovery semantics where recent history shows the strongest ownership signal.
